info.title: Nessus Vulnerability Scanner API
info.description: REST API endpoints for interacting with Tenable Nessus Vulnerability Scanner.

get.description: Get the Nessus server properties. Used for connection validation.

200.description: Returns the server status (loading, ready, corrupt-db, feed-expired, eval-expired, locked, register, register-locked, download-failed, feed-error).

503.description: Returns the server status. Indicates a session destroy is required.

get.description: Returns the Nessus server status and health details.

403.description: Returned if the user does not have permission to view the list.

get.description: List all available scan templates (e.g., Basic Network Scan, Host Discovery) and their UUIDs.

403.description: Returned if the user does not have permission to view the policy list.

get.description: Returns the list of configured vulnerability scan policies.

folder_id.description: The id of the folder whose scans should be listed.

last_modification_date.description: Limit the results to those that have only changed since this time.

get.description: List all configured vulnerability scans in Nessus.

uuid.description: The uuid for the editor template to use.

200.description: Returned if the scan was saved successfully.

500.description: Returned if an error occurred while saving the scan.

post.description: Create a new vulnerability scan for target IP addresses or subnets.

ids.description: Array of scan IDs to delete.

200.description: Returned if the scans have been successfully deleted.

400.description: Returned if a field is invalid.

403.description: Returned if the user does not have permission to delete the scans.

404.description: Returned if one or more scans does not exist.

500.description: Returned if the server failed to delete the scans.

delete.description: Delete scans in bulk. NOTE: Scans in running, paused or stopping states cannot be deleted.

parameters.name: scan_id
parameters.description: The id of the scan to retrieve.

parameters.name: history_id
parameters.description: The history_id of the historical data that should be returned.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of hosts that should be returned.

get.description: Get detailed vulnerability results and status of a specific scan.

parameters.name: scan_id
parameters.description: The id of the scan to launch.

alt_targets.description: If specified, these targets will be scanned instead of the default. Value can be an array where each index is a target, or an array with a single index of comma separated targets.

200.description: Returned if the scan was successfully launched.

403.description: Returned if the scan is disabled.

404.description: Returned if the scan does not exist.

post.description: Trigger an existing vulnerability scan to run immediately.

parameters.name: scan_id
parameters.description: The id of the scan to pause.

200.description: Returned if the scan was successfully queued to pause.

404.description: Returned if the scan does not exist.

409.description: Returned if the scan is not active.

post.description: Temporarily pause a running vulnerability scan.

parameters.name: scan_id
parameters.description: The id of the scan to resume.

200.description: Returned if the scan was successfully queued to resume.

404.description: Returned if the scan does not exist.

409.description: Returned if the scan is not active.

post.description: Resume a previously paused vulnerability scan.

parameters.name: scan_id
parameters.description: The id of the scan to stop.

200.description: Returned if the scan was successfully queued to stop.

404.description: Returned if the scan does not exist.

409.description: Returned if the scan is not active.

parameters.name: scan_id
parameters.description: The id of the scan to kill.

200.description: Returned if the scan was successfully queued to be killed.

403.description: Returned if an attempt was made to kill a remote scan.

404.description: Returned if the scan does not exist.

409.description: Returned if the scan is not active.

post.description: Forcefully terminate a running vulnerability scan on the local scanner faster than stop.

parameters.name: history_id

format.description: The file format to use (Nessus, HTML, PDF, CSV, or DB).

password.description: The password used to encrypt database exports (*Required when exporting as DB).

filters.description: An object containing filters to apply to the exported scan report.

filter.search_type.description: The type of search to be used.

200.description: Returned if the export was queued successfully.

400.description: Returned if a required parameter is missing.

404.description: Returned if the scan does not exist.

409.description: Returned if the scan is still active or in the middle of creating the report already.

post.description: Request export of vulnerability scan results into a specified file format (e.g., nessus, csv, pdf, html).

parameters.name: scan_id
parameters.description: The id of the scan to export.

parameters.name: file_id
parameters.description: The id of the file to poll (Included in response from /scans/{scan_id}/export).

200.description: Returns the status of the file. A status of "ready" indicates the file can be downloaded.

404.description: Returned if the file does not exist.

get.description: Check the generation status of an requested scan export file.

parameters.name: scan_id
parameters.description: The id of the scan to export.

parameters.name: file_id
parameters.description: The id of the file to download (Included in response from /scans/{scan_id}/export).

200.description: Returns the content of the file as an attachment.

404.description: Returned if the file does not exist.

get.description: Download a generated vulnerability scan export file once its status is ready.

403.description: Returned if the user does not have permission to view the list.

get.description: Returns the list of local and linked remote/cloud scanners.

403.description: Returned if the user does not have permission to view the list.

get.description: Returns the list of scan folders (e.g., My Scans, Trash).

id.description: The unique id of the agent group.

groups.description: The groups of which the agent is a member.

safe_mode.description: This flag indicates the last reported 'safe mode' status from the agent to Nessus Manager (1 or 0).

safe_mode_agent_count.description: The total count of agents that Nessus Manager is currently tracking as operating in 'safe mode'.

safe_mode_transition_time.description: The 'epoch time' (seconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, at 00:00:00, UTC) at which Nessus Manager changed its tracking of the 'safe mode' status for the agent.

status.description: Nessus Manager's notion of the agent's state.  Possible values are 'unlinked', 'offline', 'online', and 'initializing'.

total_agents.description: The total count of agents that Nessus Manager is currently tracking.

unlinked_on.description: The date the agent was unlinked, in unixtime.

order.description: The order that this category appears in the UI.

alert.description: A short-form description of the scanner alert.

description.description: The long-form description of the scanner alert, which may contain further details.

severity.description:
The severity of the alert, whose values are the following:
  • 1 - info
  • 3 - warning
  • 5 - critical

type.description: A category of alert types (for example, "node-load", "system-specs", etc.).

avg_dns_lookup_time.description: The average amount of time (in milliseconds) it takes to perform a DNS lookup on detected hosts.

avg_rdns_lookup_time.description: The average amount of time (in milliseconds) it takes to perform a reverse DNS lookup on detected hosts.

cpu_load_avg.description: On Unix this is the "load average" provided by the operating system. On Windows this is the current CPU usage (see also "nessus_cpu").

kbytes_received.description: The amount of data (in kilobytes) received by Nessus.

kbytes_sent.description: The amount of data (in kilobytes) sent by Nessus.

nessus_cpu.description: A normalized (0-100) value for the percentage of total system CPU available across all cores that is being used by Nessus.

nessus_data_disk_free.description:
The amount of free disk space (in megabytes) for the configuration directory. By default this corresponds to the following directory:
  • Unix - /opt/nessus/etc/nessus
  • Windows - C:\ProgramData\Tenable\Nessus\conf
  • macOS - /Library/Nessus/run/etc/nessus

nessus_data_disk_total.description:
The total disk size (in megabytes) for the configuration directory. By default this corresponds to the following directory:
  • Unix - /opt/nessus/etc/nessus
  • Windows - C:\ProgramData\Tenable\Nessus\conf
  • macOS - /Library/Nessus/run/etc/nessus

nessus_log_disk_free.description:
The amount of free disk space (in megabytes) for the "log" directory. By default this corresponds to the following directory:
  • Unix - /opt/nessus/var/nessus/logs
  • Windows - C:\ProgramData\Tenable\Nessus\nessus\logs
  • macOS - /Library/Nessus/run/var/nessus/logs

nessus_log_disk_total.description:
The total disk size (in megabytes) for the "log" directory. By default this corresponds to the following directory:
  • Unix - /opt/nessus/var/nessus/logs
  • Windows - C:\ProgramData\Tenable\Nessus\nessus\logs
  • macOS - /Library/Nessus/run/var/nessus/logs

nessus_mem.description: The total amount of real memory (in megabytes) currently in use by Nessus.

nessus_vmem.description: The total amount of virtual memory (in megabytes) currently in use by Nessus.

nessus_heap.description: The total amount of memory (in megabytes) allocated on the heap by Nessus.

num_dns_lookups.description: The number of DNS lookups performed by Nessus.

num_hosts.description: The current number of hosts that are actively being scanned.

num_rdns_lookups.description: The number of reverse DNS lookups performed by Nessus.

num_scans.description: The number of actively running scans.

num_tcp_sessions.description: The number of open TCP connections at the time of this sampling.

sys_cores.description: The total number of CPU cores available on the device, as reported by the operating system.

sys_ram.description: The total amount of RAM available on the device, as reported by the operating system.

temp_disk_free.description: The amount of free disk space (in megabytes) for the system "temp" directory (%TEMP% or $TMPDIR or /tmp).

temp_disk_total.description: The total disk size (in megabytes) for the system "temp" directory (%TEMP% or $TMPDIR or /tmp).

timestamp.description: The time (in Unix time) when this scanner statistic sampling was generated.

allow_custom.description: Indicates that the advanced setting can accept a custom value, in addition to the list of allowable values.

backend_reload.description: Indicates that changing this advanced setting will require a restart of the Nessus web server for it to take effect.

default.description: The default value of the advanced setting, if applicable.

deprecated.description: Indicates if the advanced setting has been deprecated and should no longer be used.

description.description: A description of the advanced setting.

hide_if_not_set.description: Indicates that the advanced setting should be hidden from the UI, if there is no defined value.

id.description: The unique identification value of this advanced setting.

invalid_values.description: An array of literal values that are invalid for this advanced setting.

max.description: The maximum allowable value of an "integer" type advanced setting.

min.description: The minimum allowable value of an "integer" type advanced setting.

name.description: The name of the advanced setting, as it appears in the UI.

regex.description: A regular expression that is used to validate a change to the advanced setting's value.

service_restart.description: Indicates that changing this advanced setting will require a restart of the Nessus service for it to take effect.

setting.description: The name of the advanced setting as identified by the backend.

type.description:
Defines the control type of the advanced setting in the UI. The absence of this value means it will use a text box. The supported types are as follows:
  • boolean - a drop-down box where the user can choose either "yes" or "no"
  • integer - a text box that only accepts numeric values
    • select - a drop-down box that lists allowable values
  • string - a text box

value.description: The value of an advanced setting. Sometimes it can be omitted in place of its "default" value.

installed.description: Whether Terrascan is installed or not.

path.description: The location on disk where Terrascan is installed.

terrascan.description: Boolean. Set to true if Terrascan should be installed, otherwise set to false.

id.description: The unique id of the user.

name.description: The real name of the user.

email.description: The email address for the user.

permissions.description: The role of the user as described here.

lastlogin.description: The last login for the user in unixtime.

type.description: The type of user (local or ldap).

login_fail_count.description: The number of failed login attempts for the user since the last successful login.

login_fail_total.description: The total number of failed login attempts for the user.

last_login_attempt.description: The timestamp of the last failed login attempt for the user.
